name: Oshikake Scramble "Ano Ko to Watashi, Docchi o Erabu no...?"
original_name: おしかけスクランブル「あの子とわたし、どっちを選ぶの…？」
source:
Main character moves to a rural area after poverty life in the city. One day he bumps into a cheeky girl who looks for some person. The next day this girl waits for him at his house together with another girl who claims to be protagonist's marriage partner. In such way a quiet life turns into vigorous one in co-habitation with two girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在城市中过着拮据生活后，男主角搬到了乡下。某日，他撞见一个正寻找某人的冒失女孩。第二天，这名女孩与另一名自称是主人公结婚对象的女孩，一起在他家等着他。平静的生活就这样变得热闹起来，他开始和两名女孩同居。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
